annotations.description: ClickHouse insert errors: increases in two checks in a row (CUTOVER.md §4).

spec.name: A
spec.query:
(
  max by ("host.name", table) (increase(otelcol_exporter_fusescope_clickhouse_insert_errors{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"}[10m]) > 0 or (otelcol_exporter_fusescope_clickhouse_insert_errors{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} > 0 unless otelcol_exporter_fusescope_clickhouse_insert_errors{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 10m))
)
and
(
  max by ("host.name", table) (increase(otelcol_exporter_fusescope_clickhouse_insert_errors{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"}[10m] offset 10m) > 0 or (otelcol_exporter_fusescope_clickhouse_insert_errors{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 10m > 0 unless otelcol_exporter_fusescope_clickhouse_insert_errors{"service.name"="fusescope-collector"} offset 20m))
)
